mapper.update: UPDATE resource_dependency edge SET description = declaration.declaration_payload ->> 'description', updated_at=#{now} FROM permission_dependency_declaration declaration WHERE edge.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND edge.owner_service_code=#{service} AND edge.delete_flag=0 AND declaration.id=edge.declaration_id AND declaration.tenant_id=edge.tenant_id AND declaration.source_service=#{service} AND declaration.delete_flag=0 AND edge.description IS DISTINCT FROM declaration.declaration_payload ->> 'description'
UPDATE resource_dependency SET delete_flag=id,deleted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_service_code=#{service} AND declaration_id IS NOT NULL AND delete_flag=0
